{{Quote|The big question is, how will the revelations affect Jagged Fel's chances of winning?''"<br />"''Well, Tozz, we'll have our answer when polling closes in just eight hours.|Tozz Relaton and Salia Deradal|<ref name="apocalypse" />}}
'''Tozz Relaton''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] political commentator for the [[Imperial News Network (Imperial Remnant)|Imperial News Network]]. In [[44 ABY]], Relaton and his partner, [[Salia Deradal]], covered the report on the [[Raid on Hagamoor 3|destruction]] of [[Natasi Daala]]'s&ndash;a candidate for the [[Imperial Remnant/Legends|Imperial]] [[Imperial Election of 44 ABY|election]]&ndash;campaign headquarters on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hagamoor 3]], and how it would affect incumbent [[Head of State/Legends|Head of State]] [[Jagged Fel]]'s chances of winning the election.<ref name="apocalypse" />
